<description>
Fixes #36334

The "CreateNewBlock(): block weight: ..." line was logged unconditionally and could not be turned off, filling the debug log when block templates are built frequently.

Move it behind a new "mining" logging category, enabled with -debug=mining.
</description>

<commits>
e7d91c2034 log: move CreateNewBlock() log line behind a new mining category

The "CreateNewBlock(): block weight: ..." line was logged unconditionally
and could not be turned off, filling the debug log when block templates are
built frequently.

Move it behind a new "mining" logging category, enabled with -debug=mining.
</commits>

 };
